steps.name: create .env, build the image and start Postgres, Keycloak and the hardened API
steps.cmd: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; Path('.env').write_bytes(Path('.env.example').read_bytes()); raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['docker','compose','-p','{project}','up','-d','--build','--wait']))"

steps.name: conformance: all 18 checks
expect_contains: PASS  me (alice is admin, RateLimit headers present)
PASS  create task with Idempotency-Key (created once, replay returned the same task, other body gave 422)
PASS  403 for member on admin route (bob (member) gets 403 on the audit log and on creating a team)
PASS  audit log (task create and update are in the audit trail)

steps.name: CORS preflight for the Angular origin
steps.cmd: curl -s -i -X OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/teams -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: authorization,content-type"

steps.name: a body above the limit is refused with 413
expect_contains: The request body may not be larger than 1048576 bytes.

steps.name: 35 anonymous requests end in 429
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess, sys; lines = [subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/call.py', 'GET', '/v1/me'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()[0] for _ in range(35)]; print(lines[0]); print(lines[-1])"

steps.name: the root file system is read-only
expect_contains: touch: cannot touch '/srv/test.txt': Read-only file system

steps.name: container restrictions
steps.cmd: docker inspect {project}-api-1 --format "read-only: {{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}, cap-drop: {{.HostConfig.CapDrop}}, security-opt: {{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}, memory: {{.HostConfig.Memory}}, pids: {{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}"
steps.expect_stdout: read-only: true, cap-drop: [ALL], security-opt: [no-new-privileges:true], memory: 268435456, pids: 200

steps.name: refusals are logged as security events
backup inside the database container
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db pg_dump -U tasks_admin --no-owner -f /tmp/backup.sql tasksteams

steps.name: restore into a new database
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db createdb -U tasks_admin restore_check

steps.name: load the dump
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -U tasks_admin -d restore_check -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -o /dev/null -f /tmp/backup.sql

steps.name: the restored data is there
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -U tasks_admin -d restore_check -tAc "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users) || ' users, ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks) || ' tasks'"

steps.name: remove the practice database
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db dropdb -U tasks_admin restore_check

steps.name: exercise solution
steps.expect_stdout:
first request:   allowed=True remaining=99 reset=60
last allowed:    allowed=True remaining=0 reset=30
over the limit:  allowed=False remaining=0 reset=30
new window:      allowed=True remaining=99 reset=60

cleanup.name: remove the image if it is still there
